messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Japanese, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Japanese line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Japanese Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|----------------------|------------------------|--------| | **mosse** | “moments / moves” (first hour) | 瞬間 | “moment” | OK | | **di** (line 40) | genitive “of” | の | “‑'s / of” | OK | | **prima** | “first, earliest” | 最初の | “first” | OK | | **quelle** | demonstrative “those” (beautiful things) | – (omitted) | – | UNNECESSARY (demonstrative dropped in Japanese) | | **cose** | “things” (beautiful things → sweet season) | 季節 | “season” | OK | | **belle** | “beautiful / sweet” | 甘美な | “sweet, pleasant” | OK | | **sì** | resultative “so … that” | それは | “that” (as a result clause) | OK | | **ch'a** | causal/resultative connector “so that” | ように | “so that / in order that” | OK | | **bene** | “good” (quality of hope) | 良い | “good” | OK | | **sperar** | infinitive “to hope” | 希望 | “hope” (noun) | OK | | **m'era** | “to me was” (experiencer) | 私にとって | “to me / for me” | OK | | **cagione** | “occasion, cause” | 機会 | “occasion, opportunity” | OK | | **di** (line 42) | preposition “concerning, of” | について | “about, concerning” | OK | | **quella** | demonstrative “that” (the beast) | あの | “that” (demonstrative) | OK | | **fiera** | “wild beast” | 野獣 | “wild beast” | OK | | **a** | preposition “with” (attribute) | を持つ | “has / possessing” | OK | | **la** | definite article “the” (before *pelle*) | – (omitted) | – | UNNECESSARY (articles not expressed in Japanese) | | **gaetta** | “dappled, speckled” | 斑点のある | “dappled / spotted” | OK | | **pelle** | “skin” | 皮膚 | “skin” | OK |
